sources.title: Medical Marijuana Program
sources.supported_claim: Official program hub with patient, operator, laboratory and regulatory resources.
sources.limitations: Program hub is not an operator license roster; statutory and court-order details require separate review.

sources.title: Dispensaries
sources.supported_claim: Official location-roster landing page.
sources.limitations: The introductory permit limits are not a current count of operating locations.

sources.title: Medical Marijuana Dispensaries in Pennsylvania with Product
sources.supported_claim: Roster lists Pennsylvania stores under Sunnyside, RISE, Beyond Hello, Zen Leaf, Verilife, Ascend, Ethos, Vytal Options, Organic Remedies and Maitri brands.
sources.limitations: Dated snapshot, not real-time availability. Brand listing alone does not establish parent ownership or current permit status.

sources.title: Approved Laboratories
sources.supported_claim: Approved testing list names ACT Laboratories of Pennsylvania, Keystone State Testing, Steep Hill Pennsylvania, US Cannalytics and Coral Reef Labs.
sources.limitations: Regulator-listed names retained; current trading names, ownership, test scope, fees and turnaround need direct confirmation.

sources.title: Medical Marijuana Patients
sources.supported_claim: Official patient and caregiver registration instructions, including assistance for homebound patients.
sources.limitations: Individual eligibility and caregiver approval are not determined by this directory.

sources.title: Medical Marijuana Assistance Program
sources.supported_claim: Assistance includes qualifying card-fee relief, caregiver background-check fee relief and a limited PACE/PACENET purchase-assistance pilot.
sources.limitations: Do not describe purchase assistance as available to every patient or every veteran.

sources.title: Medical Marijuana Regulations
sources.supported_claim: Official entry point for program regulations.
sources.limitations: Read with regulator announcements and applicable court orders; not a complete current-law review.

sources.title: Growers-Processors
sources.supported_claim: Page describes operator application materials, strain-name requests and a per-permit seed-to-sale API approval process.
sources.limitations: Page reports a March 2026 court injunction concerning added botanical terpenes. FAQ permit ceilings are not operating counts.

sources.title: Retail locations
sources.supported_claim: First-party retail page lists Beyond / Hello Pennsylvania locations, including Mt. Pocono.
sources.limitations: No claim of complete statewide coverage or availability at an individual store.

sources.title: Pennsylvania dispensaries
sources.supported_claim: First-party page identifies Pennsylvania medical dispensaries and Green Thumb branding.
sources.limitations: Promotions, hours and inventory change; do not infer a grower permit from retail presence.

sources.title: Pennsylvania dispensaries
sources.supported_claim: First-party Pennsylvania location route and state roster support medical retail presence.
sources.limitations: Page includes navigation for other states; use the Pennsylvania section only.

sources.title: Pennsylvania dispensaries
sources.supported_claim: First-party page identifies Pennsylvania medical retail locations.
sources.limitations: Reuse the existing Ethos identity rather than the separate historical counterparty placeholder; verify specific license entities before importing locations.

sources.title: Locations
sources.supported_claim: Provider lists Pennsylvania dispensary destinations including Harrisburg, Lancaster and State College.
sources.limitations: Parent/legal entity and cultivation permits need separate reconciliation.

sources.title: Locations
sources.supported_claim: Provider lists Pennsylvania dispensary locations and contact routes.
sources.limitations: Retail presence does not by itself verify cultivation permits or stock.

sources.title: Our Story
sources.supported_claim: Provider identifies Southwestern Pennsylvania roots and Pennsylvania medical cannabis patient services.
sources.limitations: Ownership and individual permit entities not reconciled in this batch.

sources.title: Pennsylvania
sources.supported_claim: Provider describes a Pennsylvania cultivation operation.
sources.limitations: Self-described operation; grower permit/legal entity and ownership changes require roster reconciliation before canonical publication.

sources.title: Industry trade association
sources.supported_claim: Pennsylvania cannabis trade association offering regulatory affairs, advocacy and member resources.
sources.limitations: Representation claims do not establish every member or an endorsement of the directory.

sources.title: Coalition formation
sources.supported_claim: Organization describes a Pennsylvania adult-use legalization advocacy coalition.
sources.limitations: Historical formation announcement, not evidence of enacted legalization or a current event.

sources.title: Pennsylvania cannabis consultants
sources.supported_claim: Dedicated Pennsylvania consulting route supports a proposed PA service listing.
sources.limitations: Provider statement; availability, scope, fee and client relationships not independently verified.

sources.title: Pennsylvania coalition membership
sources.supported_claim: Provider announced joining the Pennsylvania Cannabis Coalition in April 2025.
sources.limitations: Historical self-reported membership; not confirmation of current dues status or a partnership with Pocono AI.

sources.title: Cannabis Regulatory Compliance at a Glance
sources.supported_claim: Firm describes Pennsylvania cannabis licensing and regulatory representation.
sources.limitations: July 2025 first-party experience brochure; current engagement acceptance and fees unconfirmed.

sources.title: Cannabis Law Solutions
sources.supported_claim: Harrisburg practice describes cannabis licensing, operations and regulatory legal work.
sources.limitations: Practice identity should be represented under its firm identity at import; do not create separate duplicates for practice and firm.

sources.title: Cannabis Banking
sources.supported_claim: Credit union explicitly offers cannabis business banking to Pennsylvania and New Jersey businesses.
sources.limitations: Subject to institution eligibility and approval; no promised account opening or credit.

sources.title: Cannabis Banking
sources.supported_claim: Bank explicitly identifies Pennsylvania among cannabis banking service markets.
sources.limitations: Account access and terms require bank approval; not an endorsement or guaranteed acceptance.

sources.title: Operation 1620
sources.supported_claim: Provider lists Pennsylvania in its veteran cannabis certification support program.
sources.limitations: Funding and partner capacity constrain support; do not promise reimbursement, certification or free cannabis.

sources.title: Clean Slate FAQ
sources.supported_claim: Explains Pennsylvania record-clearing routes and directs users to legal help.
sources.limitations: General information; not automatic eligibility for all cannabis convictions or statewide direct representation.

sources.title: Record-clearing
sources.supported_claim: Offers record-clearing help in Bucks, Chester, Delaware and Montgomery counties.
sources.limitations: Eligibility screening applies; page says it is not currently assisting with pardon applications.

sources.title: Criminal record expungement
sources.supported_claim: Official process describes obtaining a record and pursuing court-ordered expungement.
sources.limitations: Requesting a record is not itself an expungement petition or determination of eligibility.

sources.supported_claim: Agency page discusses license verification, business documents, expected activity and ongoing monitoring.
sources.limitations: Page contains legacy federal-law language and dated guidance. Use as a workflow-discovery source, not a current federal scheduling, tax or SAR legal determination.
